Name: Custom NPC Fixes
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Custom NPC Fixes[/b] fixes NPC spawning in custom locations, pathing to custom locations, and schedules for new NPCs.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
This mod works automatically for all custom NPCs when installed.

[b]Note for mod authors:[/b] you only need this mod when adding locations through TMXL. Locations added through Content Patcher work just like vanilla and don't need it.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[/list]
